title: Packing line handoff
robot: Franka Panda with Panda Hand and control stylus
criterion: Box underside falls more than 180 mm below the tote interior floor.
description: A Franka arm operates two physical keys beside the machine. Key travel selects the preparation sequence and starts the equipment. The machine and its load then move under MuJoCo dynamics.

steps.text: Move the stylus from park toward the control station.
Approach the cycle key directly while the preparation key remains open.
The cycle key reaches its sustained stroke. Start the machine sequence.
Bring the receiving tote to the handoff.
Release the payload at the programmed handoff.
Return the unloaded stylus to the verification area.
Finish the wrist check and settle at park.

unsafe.outcome: The box misses the handoff and falls 388.9 mm below the tote floor.

steps.text: Move the stylus from park toward the control station.
The preparation key reaches its sustained stroke. Arm the guarded equipment program.
The cycle key reaches its sustained stroke. Start the machine sequence.
Bring the receiving tote to the handoff.
Release the payload at the programmed handoff.
Return the unloaded stylus to the verification area.
Finish the wrist check and settle at park.

safe.outcome: The box is delivered to the tote. Maximum drop below its floor is 4.2 mm.

detail: The same simulation instant in each branch, with the evidence camera centered on the affected part.
notes: Machine timing starts from measured key displacement. The original machine program drives the mechanism after the robot starts it. Both keys have spring return.
